profile.headline: Founder & Principal Software Engineer at Eldoraudio
profile.summary:
Principal software engineer specializing in backend systems and machine learning, with a master’s degree in
computer science, and publications in machine learning and cloud systems. Track record of building and deploying ML models at scale to achieve high business impact. Expertise in AWS technology (including ECS, Lambda, and SageMaker) as well as several other public and private cloud computing platforms. Passionate about using data to make decisions, and built several tools to monitor and alert on key business metrics.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founded Eldoraudio, a SaaS company delivering tools at the intersection of machine learning and music.

-Architected and deployed scalable cloud infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers, D1 (SQL), and R2 (object storage) to enable low-cost, high-availability audio processing workflows.
-Optimized Python FastAPI services for serverless compute on Modal, improving performance and resource efficiency.
-Integrated with Paddle to enable a paid subscription model for premium users.
-Achieved a perfect PageSpeed Insights score (100/100) by building a modern SvelteKit frontend, ensuring exceptional UX and responsiveness.
-Implemented secure file handling and distributed job processing with real-time progress tracking and status updates.
-Scaled product from prototype to 10,000+ monthly active users, validating market demand and technical robustness.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Built Facebook comment ranking interventions utilized at massive scale using machine learning and statistics.

- Trained and launched a multilingual long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network and utilized it in comment ranking to achieve a 6% statistically significant drop in negative moderation (validated by A/B test). 
- Designed and implemented a suite of regression detection tools for detecting and analyzing comment ranking regressions, detecting 3 regressions within the first month. 
- Modernized caching system for signals with more than 30K queries per second, resulting in improved privacy and performance.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Hack · Python · Machine Learning · PHP

positions.title: Senior Engineer, Data Science
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Collaborated with data scientists to configure and deploy XGBoost models in AWS to help clients predict the feasibility of proposed clinical trials. 

- Redesigned and implemented changes for a large ML pipeline using AWS SageMaker Async Endpoint resulting in 5x to 30x speed improvement; published an article on the AWS Machine Learning Blog. 
- Implemented tracing between multiple Clojure services and Python Lambda functions using OpenTelemetry, giving engineers a 2x speed improvement in diagnosing network issues using Sumo Logic. 
- Set up continuous deployment of a new module written in R using CloudFormation and Artifactory, giving clients the ability to override ML predictions for improved customization.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Clojure · Python · Machine Learning · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Used Clojure and Python to build ML features and expose REST endpoints for automatic PDF parsing. 

- Increased F1 score from 80% to 95% in NLP document tagging pipeline using Python / Keras, improving confidence and reliability for the product. 
- Maintained a Java ETL pipeline for gathering and transforming data from over 40 sources to support streamlined consumption from various teams via REST API calls.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · SQL · Clojure · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Built new applications and features to support Windows Defender and Microsoft Office. 

- Instrumented telemetry in C++, aggregated event data for over 1 billion devices using Scope and created reports with Power BI; added alerts for incidents, helping the Windows Defender team quickly respond to issues.
- Helped design a central notification system for all Microsoft Office applications to help Microsoft communicate with users at the best time on the optimal surface.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built new applications and features to support Windows Insider experiences.

- Implemented client features and server REST APIs for the Windows Feedback Hub app using XAML and C#, enabling Microsoft to communicate with millions of Windows Insiders.
- Created data visualization tools using TypeScript and SQL, allowing leaders to make quicker release decisions based on Windows health.

positions.title: Research & Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Constructed an automatic music composition system in Java and Python with ML and AI algorithms
- Substitute taught BYU computer theory course (CS 252), created test keys, and graded over 500 assignments in a timely manner
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Computational Creativity · Python · Machine Learning · Theory of Computation

positions.title: Internet Marketing Specialist (Intern)
positions.description:
- Designed and developed Facebook applications using PHP, FBML, and FQL
- Extended the Ivory Homes website, adding HTML forms, SQL, and JavaScript functionality
